sentences.en: And so receiving this information, unlike other decisions in our life,
sentences.zh: 因此，接收这些信息——不像我们生活中的其他决定，

sentences.en: like you could think in our daily life if you're going to get a raise or anything like this,
sentences.zh: 比如你可以想想在日常生活中，如果你要加薪或者诸如此类的事，

sentences.en: that information can be very useful because it'll help you improve your purchase decisions right now in the present.
sentences.zh: 这类信息可能会非常有用，因为它能帮助你改进当前正进行的购买决策。

sentences.en: But here they're basically stuck sitting in the lab in a seat.
sentences.zh: 但在这里，他们基本上只能困在实验室的座位上。

sentences.en: And so receiving this information 20 minutes earlier is completely useless.
sentences.zh: 因此，提前20分钟接收到这个信息是完全无用的。

sentences.en: They can't use it to improve any decisions in that short interim period.
sentences.zh: 在那个短暂的过渡期内，他们无法用它来改进任何决策。

sentences.en: Even if receiving the information earlier was useless,
sentences.zh: 尽管提前接收信息毫无用处，

sentences.en: lots of volunteers were perfectly willing to pay to find out what was inside the envelope sooner.
sentences.zh: 但许多志愿者仍然非常愿意花钱，以便能更早知道信封里面是什么。

sentences.en: The bigger the potential good news, the more likely volunteers were to pay.
sentences.zh: 潜在的好消息越大，志愿者花钱的意愿就越强烈。

sentences.en: The studies show that people are hungry for information when information is pleasant.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，当信息令人愉快时，人们对信息的渴望非常强烈。

sentences.en: Now, there's one important detail we haven't told you yet.
sentences.zh: 现在，还有一个我们尚未告诉你的重要细节。

sentences.en: The amount the volunteers had to pay wasn't very much, just 50 cents to open an envelope.
sentences.zh: 志愿者必须支付的金额并不多，只需50美分就可以打开一个信封。

sentences.en: Since the big envelope could hold as much as $100, you might say that paying 50 cents was a trivial coSt.
sentences.zh: 既然大信封里最多可能有100美元，你可能会说付50美分代价微乎其微。

sentences.en: We wanted to look at something that had greater real-world stakes.
sentences.zh: 我们想研究一些在现实世界中影响更大的事情。

sentences.en: We know people want pleasant information.
sentences.zh: 我们知道人们想要令人愉快的信息。

sentences.en: But are they willing to pay to avoid unpleasant news, like information about a disease?
sentences.zh: 但他们是否愿意花钱去回避令人不快的新闻，比如关于某种疾病的信息？

sentences.en: Josh and Ananda decided to find out.
sentences.zh: 乔什和阿南达决定一探究竟。

sentences.en: They thought about the health concerns you might see on a college campus.
sentences.zh: 他们想到了你可能会在大学校园里见到的健康问题。

sentences.en: The sample that we have access to are college undergrads, right?
sentences.zh: 我们能接触到的样本是大学本科生，对吧？

sentences.en: And so we could do something like a cancer test, but I don't think college undergrads are terribly concerned about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们可以做类似癌症检测的事情，但我认为大学本科生对那个并不是特别关心。

sentences.en: I think what college undergrads tend to be typically concerned about is STDs.
sentences.zh: 我认为大学本科生通常关心的往往是性传播感染（STD）。

sentences.en: We chose HSV because the rate of prevalence of HSV in this population is rather high.
sentences.zh: 我们选择单纯疱疹病毒（HSV）是因为这种病毒在该群体中的患病率相当高。

sentences.en: I mean, rough numbers are around 50%.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，粗略数字大约是50%。

sentences.en: Chances are every other person has it, so they would have it.
sentences.zh: 很有可能身边的每两个人中就有一个人携带有这种病毒，也就是说他们会感染。

sentences.en: And then the other attractive thing about HSV for us is that there's kind of two levels,
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，HSV的另一个吸引人之处在于它有两种层级，

sentences.en: kind of parallel, a $10 and $100 thing.
sentences.zh: 有点类似于10美元和100美元的情况。

sentences.en: There's herpes simplex virus 1 and herpes simplex virus 2.
sentences.zh: 有单纯疱疹病毒1型和单纯疱疹病毒2型。

sentences.en: Herpes simplex virus 1 is typically associated with cold sores,
sentences.zh: 单纯疱疹病毒1型通常与唇疱疹相关，

sentences.en: and herpes simplex virus 2 is typically associated with genital herpes.
sentences.zh: 而单纯疱疹病毒2型通常与生殖器疱疹相关。

sentences.en: HSV-1, it's the oral herpes, is less considered to be less severe or less stigmatic or whatever in the population.
sentences.zh: HSV-1，也就是口腔疱疹，在人群中通常被认为没有那么严重，或者没有那么强的污名化之类的。

sentences.en: Ananda and Josh asked college students to come back to their lab.
sentences.zh: 阿南达和乔什邀请大学生回到他们的实验室。

sentences.en: This time, volunteers were asked to sit through a webinar about herpes.
sentences.zh: 这一次，志愿者被要求听一场关于疱疹的网络研讨会。

sentences.en: We actually give them photographs of sores on the lips and photographs of sores on male and female genitalia
sentences.zh: 我们实际上向他们展示了嘴唇上溃疡的照片，以及男性和女性生殖器上溃疡的照片，

sentences.en: with a discussion of HSV-1 and HSV-2.
sentences.zh: 并对HSV-1和HSV-2进行了讨论。

sentences.en: And these pictures were graphic?
sentences.zh: 这些照片很直观吗？

sentences.en: These pictures were very graphic.
sentences.zh: 这些照片非常直观。

sentences.en: In fact, we don't know that we'll be able to, we'll want to put it in the paper.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们不知道自己是否能、是否愿意把它放进论文里。

sentences.en: They were completely clinical graphic.
sentences.zh: 它们完全是临床医学般直观的图片。

sentences.en: Since Josh and Ananda knew that some people avoid getting tested for herpes
sentences.zh: 既然乔什和阿南达知道有些人会避免进行疱疹检测，

sentences.en: because they don't want to deal with a blood test,
sentences.zh: 是因为他们不想应付抽血化验，

sentences.en: volunteers were told they had to have their blood drawn in order to stay in the study.
sentences.zh: 志愿者被告知，为了留在研究中，他们必须抽血。

sentences.en: The researchers told volunteers they could have the blood tested for free for both kinds of herpes.
sentences.zh: 研究人员告诉志愿者，他们的血液可以免费检测这两种疱疹。

sentences.en: Volunteers were assured confidentiality.
sentences.zh: 研究人员向志愿者保证了保密性。

sentences.en: They were allowed to call into the lab with their initials and four randomly selected numbers of their own choice.
sentences.zh: 他们可以用自己的姓名缩写和自己随机挑选的四个数字打电话到实验室。

sentences.en: Even the doctor would not know who they were.
sentences.zh: 就连医生也不会知道他们是谁。

sentences.en: So, to recap, students were given graphic information about two forms of herpes.
sentences.zh: 所以，简而言之，学生们被告知了关于两种疱疹的直观信息。

sentences.en: The researchers then proceeded to eliminate all the usual reasons someone might not want to get tested for the sexually transmitted disease.
sentences.zh: 接着，研究人员排除了人们可能不想检测这种性传播疾病的所有常规理由。

sentences.en: It was mandatory for the volunteers to get their blood drawn, the test was free, and the results would be obtained confidentially.
sentences.zh: 志愿者必须抽血是强制性的，检测是免费的，而且结果将以保密方式获取。

sentences.en: Would volunteers elect to find out if they had herpes?
sentences.zh: 志愿者会选择查明自己是否得了疱疹吗？

sentences.en: Or would they choose to bury their heads in the sand?
sentences.zh: 还是会选择掩耳盗铃？

sentences.en: To test for information aversion, the researchers told the volunteers that they would have to pay $10 to not get their blood tested.
sentences.zh: 为了测试信息厌恶，研究人员告诉志愿者，他们必须支付10美元才能不抽血检测。

sentences.en: A significant number of volunteers elected to pay this money.
sentences.zh: 相当一部分志愿者选择花这笔钱。

sentences.en: And just as the researchers had expected, volunteers were more likely to pay money to avoid getting highly unpleasant information about genital herpes
sentences.zh: 正如研究人员所预料的那样，志愿者更有可能花钱去避免获得关于生殖器疱疹的高度不愉快信息，

sentences.en: than the less unpleasant information about oral herpes.
sentences.zh: 而不是关于口腔疱疹的相对不那么不愉快的信息。

sentences.en: Tell me about those people.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲那些人。

sentences.en: So, they just sat, did that happen in front of them, or how did that happen?
sentences.zh: 所以，他们就坐在那儿，这事是在他们面前发生的，还是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: So, the phlebotomist drew the blood, and we said, okay, so this was your choice.
sentences.zh: 抽血师抽了血，然后我们说，好的，这就是你的选择。

sentences.en: You had chosen not to be tested, so now this blood would be discarded.
sentences.zh: 你选择不进行检测，所以现在这些血将被丢弃。

sentences.en: Would you please drop it down the sink and wash it out?
sentences.zh: 你能把它倒进水槽里并冲洗掉吗？

sentences.en: And they did.
sentences.zh: 他们照做了。

sentences.en: They did.
sentences.zh: 他们真的照做了。

sentences.en: They would drop the tube into the sink and turn on the faucet, and it would fill.
sentences.zh: 他们把试管扔进水槽，打开水龙头，水漫了上来。

sentences.en: I mean, at some level, that has to be a little bit disturbing, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从某种程度上讲，这必然有点让人不安吧？

sentences.en: The idea that you're drawing blood and throwing it down the sink?
sentences.zh: 抽了血却把它倒进水槽里这种想法？

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: And that's kind of the point here, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，这也是这里的关键所在。

sentences.en: So, they are going to have the blood drawn.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们还是抽了血。

sentences.en: So, you'd rather pay money, waste that blood, than know what your test results were.
sentences.zh: 因此，你宁愿花钱、浪费这些血，也不愿知道你的检测结果。

sentences.en: Did any of the students give you verbal feedback about what happened and their impressions of it?
sentences.zh: 有没有学生向你们提供关于所发生的事情及其感想的口头反馈？

sentences.en: Did any of them explain why they declined to be tested?
sentences.zh: 他们中有人解释为什么要拒绝检测吗？

sentences.en: I mean, they obviously must have thought about what the implications were as they made the choice.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们在做出选择时，显然一定考虑过其中的含义。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, we actually asked them, what was your motivation?
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们确实问过他们：“你的动机是什么？”

sentences.en: 85.7%, the most common explanation was because, quote,
sentences.zh: 85.7%的最常见解释是因为，原话是：

sentences.en: it will cause me unnecessary stress or anxiety if I test positive.
sentences.zh: “如果我检测呈阳性，这会给我带来不必要的压力或焦虑。”

sentences.en: It's worth pointing out that lots of students elected to receive the information about whether they had herpes.
sentences.zh: 值得指出的是，许多学生选择接收关于他们是否患有疱疹的信息。

sentences.en: In fact, a majority of students elected to do the rational thing and get their blood tested.
sentences.zh: 事实上，大多数学生选择做理性的事，去抽血检测。

sentences.en: But that isn't surprising.
sentences.zh: 但这并不令人意外。

sentences.en: The surprising thing is that that number wasn't 100% because...
sentences.zh: 令人意外的是，这个比例没有达到100%，因为……

sentences.en: You should always be willing to hear information about your finances or your health.
sentences.zh: 你理应随时愿意听取有关你财务状况或健康状况的信息。

sentences.en: As many as 20% of the students were willing to pay cold, hard cash to avoid finding out that they had genital herpes.
sentences.zh: 高达20%的学生愿意花真金白银来避免发现自己患有生殖器疱疹。

sentences.en: Another thing the researchers found, students who were in a good mood were more likely to avoid information than those in a bad mood.
sentences.zh: 研究人员发现的另一件事是，心情好的学生比心情差的学生更有可能回避信息。

sentences.en: This may seem surprising, but it actually makes complete sense.
sentences.zh: 这看起来可能令人意外，但实际上完全合乎情理。

sentences.en: When you're in a good mood, do you really want to ruin how you feel by discovering you have herpes?
sentences.zh: 当你心情大好时，你真的会想通过发现自己得了疱疹来毁掉这种感觉吗？

sentences.en: It's like an ignorance is bliss result.
sentences.zh: 这就好比是“难得糊涂”的结果。

sentences.en: Think for a moment about the implications of information aversion.
sentences.zh: 花一点时间想想信息厌恶的含义。

sentences.en: So many health and well-being messages are premised on the idea that people will act rationally when it comes to preserving their health.
sentences.zh: 许多健康和幸福相关的宣传都基于这样一个前提：人们在维护自身健康时会理性行事。

sentences.en: What if that isn't true for a sizable number of people?
sentences.zh: 如果对于相当一部分人来说事实并非如此呢？

sentences.en: I think that we should consider whether scare tactics in advertising and things like that, I mean,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们应该考虑广告中的吓唬战术以及诸如此类的手段，我的意思是，

sentences.en: whether that is a good technique to encourage people to get tested or not is questionable.
sentences.zh: 这究竟是不是鼓励人们去检测的好方法，是值得商榷的。

sentences.en: When we come back, we're going to leave the lab and head out into the real world to see how information aversion plays out in everyday life.
sentences.zh: 当我们回来时，我们将离开实验室，走向现实世界，看看信息厌恶如何在日常生活中上演。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: There's no question that fear is an effective way to change how people behave.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，恐惧是改变人们行为的有效方法。

sentences.en: When a parent tells a kid to fall in line or risk losing iPad privileges for a week, or when a boss tells an employee to come into work on time or risk getting fired,
sentences.zh: 当父母告诉孩子听话，否则一周内取消使用iPad的特权时，或者当老板告诉员工按时上班否则面临被解雇的风险时，

sentences.en: these often produce the desired effect.
sentences.zh: 这些往往能产生预期的效果。

sentences.en: We use scare tactics in public service announcements all the time, like in this road safety commercial from Thailand, where a speeding car runs into a group of pedestrians.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在公共服务公告中使用吓唬战术，比如泰国这个交通安全广告，其中一辆超速行驶的汽车撞向了一群行人。

sentences.en: Or this anti-smoking advertisement from Poland, where a lit cigarette is transformed into a candle at the base of a tombstone.
sentences.zh: 或者波兰这个反吸烟广告，一根点燃的香烟变成了一块墓碑底部的蜡烛。

sentences.en: In Josh and Josh and Ananda study, the majority of volunteers chose to get tested after being exposed to graphic images of herpes.
sentences.zh: 在乔什和阿南达的研究中，大多数志愿者在接触到疱疹的直观图像后，都选择接受检测。

sentences.en: This makes sense, says University of Illinois psychology professor Dolores Alboracen.
sentences.zh: 伊利诺伊大学心理学教授多洛雷斯·阿尔博拉森表示，这合情合理。

sentences.en: If you induce a significant level of fear, you're going to get a comparable reaction on the behavioral side.
sentences.zh: 如果你引发了显著程度的恐惧，你在行为方面就会得到相应的反应。

sentences.en: Dolores and a team of researchers analyzed 250 studies done about the effectiveness of fear in transforming behavior.
sentences.zh: 多洛雷斯和一组研究人员分析了250项关于恐惧在改变行为方面有效性的研究。

sentences.en: While the research shows fear indeed is effective, Dolores says it has limitations.
sentences.zh: 尽管研究表明恐惧确实有效，但多洛雷斯表示它也有局限性。

sentences.en: It does work better for one-time behavior.
sentences.zh: 它对一次性行为确实更有效。

sentences.en: So getting vaccinated, if I have a threat and there is an effective vaccine right after and I just go in and get it one time, that's easy to do.
sentences.zh: 所以接种疫苗，如果我面临威胁，随后马上有有效的疫苗，我去打一次就行了，这很容易做到。

sentences.en: The behavior is done right after you experience the emotion.
sentences.zh: 这种行为发生在你体验到情绪之后。

sentences.en: Emotions are not that long-lasting, so it's going to have an effect.
sentences.zh: 情绪不会持续那么久，所以它会产生效果。

sentences.en: But if it comes down to following the right diet, we all know how difficult that is.
sentences.zh: 但如果要落实到遵循正确的饮食习惯，我们都知道这有多难。

sentences.en: And whatever fear you might experience at one point is gone the next day.
sentences.zh: 你在某一刻感受到的恐惧，第二天就会消失。

sentences.en: This is the crux of the issue.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题的核心所在。

sentences.en: If you want someone to do something one time, frightening them into doing it could be very effective.
sentences.zh: 如果你想让某人做一次某事，用恐惧来吓唬他们可能会非常有效。

sentences.en: But if you want them to do something regularly and over a long period of time, fear might not be effective.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想让他们定期且长期地做某事，恐惧可能就没那么有效了。

sentences.en: In fact, some research suggests it could be counterproductive.
sentences.zh: 事实上，一些研究表明，这可能会适得其反。

sentences.en: Let me just have you start, if you don't mind, by just introducing yourself and tell me your name.
sentences.zh: 如果你不介意的话，我想请你先自我介绍一下，告诉我你的名字。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: My name is Ritesh Banerjee.
sentences.zh: 我叫里特什·班纳吉。

sentences.en: I'm an economiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是一名经济学家。

sentences.en: A few years ago, Ritesh and his colleague, Giulio Zanella, began looking at data about 3,000 American women who all worked at a large company.
sentences.zh: 几年前，里特什和他的同事朱利奥·扎内拉开始研究3000名美国女性的数据，她们都在一家大公司工作。

sentences.en: All the women were between the ages of 50 and 64, and they were all covered by an insurance plan that provided a free mammogram every year.
sentences.zh: 所有这些女性的年龄都在50岁到64岁之间，她们都享有提供每年一次免费乳腺X光检查的保险计划。

sentences.en: Which is perceived to be an important tool in the fight against breast cancer.
sentences.zh: 这被认为是抗击乳腺癌的重要工具。

sentences.en: This company made a real push to help women get screened for breast cancer.
sentences.zh: 这家公司大力推动女性进行乳腺癌筛查。

sentences.en: It would automatically schedule mammograms for staffers and then remind women about upcoming appointments.
sentences.zh: 它会自动为员工预约乳腺X光检查，然后提醒女性即将到来的预约。

sentences.en: Screenings were conducted right at the company, so they were easy to get to, and the wait times were minimal.
sentences.zh: 筛查就在公司内部进行，因此很容易前往，而且等待时间极短。

sentences.en: In other words, many of the barriers that keep women from getting tested were absent at this company.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这家公司消除了许多阻碍女性接受检测的障碍。

sentences.en: Ritesh wanted to find out how the decisions of women to get screened for breast cancer were shaped by information aversion.
sentences.zh: 里特什想要弄清楚，女性进行乳腺癌筛查的决定是如何受到信息回避影响的。

sentences.en: He obtained detailed information from the company about employees, including their health status,
sentences.zh: 他从公司获得了有关员工的详细信息，包括他们的健康状况，

sentences.en: and where they physically sat in relation to one another.
sentences.zh: 以及他们彼此相对的座位位置。

sentences.en: He discovered that when one staffer was diagnosed with breast cancer,
sentences.zh: 他发现，当一名员工被诊断出患有乳腺癌时，

sentences.en: this dramatically changed the behavior of other women who worked in her vicinity.
sentences.zh: 这会极大地改变她附近其他女性同事的行为。

sentences.en: We find that, on average, when a woman is diagnosed with breast cancer,
sentences.zh: 我们发现，平均而言，当一名女性被诊断出患有乳腺癌时，

sentences.en: her co-workers, her immediate co-workers, female co-workers,
sentences.zh: 她的同事，她的直接同事，女性同事，

sentences.en: reduce their propensity to have a breast screening in the year in which the diagnosis takes place.
sentences.zh: 会减少她们在确诊当年进行乳腺筛查的倾向。

sentences.en: And this impact is persistent for at least two more years after the diagnosis for that woman.
sentences.zh: 而且这种影响在该女性确诊后至少持续两年。

sentences.en: Women in the closest proximity to the woman who was diagnosed with breast cancer learn of this information.
sentences.zh: 与确诊乳腺癌的女性距离最近的女性了解到了这一信息。

sentences.en: Their willingness to screen falls the moSt.
sentences.zh: 她们进行筛查的意愿下降幅度最大。

sentences.en: Ritesh found that the severity of the disease was key.
sentences.zh: 里特什发现，疾病的严重程度是关键所在。

sentences.en: Women who had a co-worker diagnosed with early-stage breast cancer
sentences.zh: 同事被诊断出患有早期乳腺癌的女性

sentences.en: were less likely to skip their annual screenings.
sentences.zh: 不太可能跳过她们的年度筛查。

sentences.en: But if a woman had a more aggressive case of breast cancer,
sentences.zh: 但如果女性患的是更具侵袭性的乳腺癌，

sentences.en: her colleagues were the ones who were more likely to skip the screenings.
sentences.zh: 她的同事反而更有可能跳过筛查。

sentences.en: So it appears in our data that in groups where the stage of the cancer is late stage,
sentences.zh: 因此我们的数据显示，在癌症处于晚期的群体中，

sentences.en: so not an earlier stage of cancer,
sentences.zh: 也就是说不是癌症早期阶段，

sentences.en: the avoidance behavior that we're observing is stronger.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到的回避行为更强烈。

sentences.en: Women who knew a co-worker who was dying from breast cancer
sentences.zh: 认识因乳腺癌去世的同事的女性

sentences.en: were the most likely to skip their mammograMs.
sentences.zh: 最有可能跳过乳腺X光检查。

sentences.en: Seeing a colleague suffer may have frightened these women from obtaining information about their own health.
sentences.zh: 看到同事遭受痛苦，可能吓得这些女性不敢去了解她们自己的健康状况。

sentences.en: Not long ago, I was playing sports with a friend on a weekend.
sentences.zh: 不久前的一个周末，我和一个朋友一起运动。

sentences.en: I was trying to change directions quickly when my ankle gave out from under me.
sentences.zh: 我正试图快速变向时，脚踝突然软了一下支撑不住。

sentences.en: I felt a sharp pain and collapsed.
sentences.zh: 我感到一阵剧痛，然后倒了下来。

sentences.en: In a matter of moments, my ankle started to swell up.
sentences.zh: 转眼间，我的脚踝就开始肿胀起来。

sentences.en: It was like watching a balloon inflate.
sentences.zh: 就像看着气球充气一样。

sentences.en: I got some ice on the ankle right away,
sentences.zh: 我马上给脚踝敷了冰块，

sentences.en: but when the pain and swelling didn't subside,
sentences.zh: 但当疼痛和肿胀没有消退，

sentences.en: and I found I could put no weight on the ankle,
sentences.zh: 而且我发现脚踝根本无法承重时，

sentences.en: I decided I had to go to the emergency room.
sentences.zh: 我决定必须去急诊室。

sentences.en: The pain in my ankle as my friend drove me to the ER
sentences.zh: 当朋友开车送我去急诊室时，脚踝传来的痛楚

sentences.en: was nowhere as bad as the pain in my head.
sentences.zh: 远不及我脑海中的恐惧来得剧烈。

sentences.en: Already, I had visions of needing surgery
sentences.zh: 我已经在脑补自己需要做手术

sentences.en: and being incapacitated for a long period of time.
sentences.zh: 并且长期丧失行动能力的情景了。

sentences.en: I desperately wanted to believe my injury wasn't serious.
sentences.zh: 我拼命想要相信我的伤并不严重。

sentences.en: When I got to the ER, the triage nurse took one look at my ballooned ankle
sentences.zh: 当我到达急诊室时，分诊护士看了一眼我肿得像气球的脚踝，

sentences.en: and told me it was broken.
sentences.zh: 就告诉我骨折了。

sentences.en: I argued with her and told her the pain wasn't that bad.
sentences.zh: 我和她争辩，说痛得没那么厉害。

sentences.en: When someone took my blood pressure and found that it was high,
sentences.zh: 当有人给我量血压发现血压偏高时，

sentences.en: I insisted they measure it again until they got a lower reading.
sentences.zh: 我坚持让他们重新测量，直到测出较低的读数。

sentences.en: I didn't think of it at the time,
sentences.zh: 当时我没有意识到这一点，

sentences.en: but what I was experiencing was information aversion.
sentences.zh: 但我所经历的正是信息回避。

sentences.en: I knew I had hurt myself,
sentences.zh: 我知道自己受伤了，

sentences.en: but I didn't want to know how badly.
sentences.zh: 但我不想知道伤得有多重。

sentences.en: As it turned out, the ankle wasn't broken.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，脚踝并没有骨折。

sentences.en: It was just a very bad sprain.
sentences.zh: 只是严重的扭伤而已。

sentences.en: In the grand scheme of things,
sentences.zh: 从宏观角度来看，

sentences.en: an ankle sprain is a trivial problem.
sentences.zh: 脚踝扭伤是个微不足道的问题。

sentences.en: It isn't cancer or heart disease or a serious infection.
sentences.zh: 它不是癌症、心脏病或严重的感染。

sentences.en: It isn't bankruptcy or like losing a job.
sentences.zh: 它不是破产，也不像失业。

sentences.en: But it made me realize that if I could experience
sentences.zh: 但它让我意识到，如果我在这么小的事情上

sentences.en: information aversion for something so small,
sentences.zh: 都会经历信息回避，

sentences.en: it's hardly surprising that people experience
sentences.zh: 那么当风险更高时，人们会经历

sentences.en: much more information aversion when the stakes are higher.
sentences.zh: 多得多的信息回避也就不足为奇了。

sentences.en: People who avoid information rationally know
sentences.zh: 理性回避信息的人其实心里清楚，

sentences.en: that they would be better off if they fully understood the bad news.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能完全了解坏消息，情况反而会更好。

sentences.en: You should always be willing to hear information
sentences.zh: 你应该总是愿意听取关于

sentences.en: about your finances or your health.
sentences.zh: 你的财务状况或健康状况的信息。

sentences.en: But deep in the brain,
sentences.zh: 但在大脑深处，

sentences.en: there are rules that tell us to avoid things
sentences.zh: 有一些规则告诉我们要避开那些

sentences.en: that are unpleasant, painful, or scary.
sentences.zh: 令人不快、痛苦或害怕的事物。

sentences.en: Like listeners Jason, Annie, and Nancy,
sentences.zh: 就像听众杰森、安妮和南希一样，

sentences.en: we shut out the news we'd rather not hear.
sentences.zh: 我们把那些宁愿不听的消息屏蔽在外。

sentences.en: If we want people to pay attention to negative information,
sentences.zh: 如果我们想让人们关注负面信息，

sentences.en: we can't assume that they will behave like rational robots.
sentences.zh: 我们就不能假设他们会像理性的机器人那样行事。

sentences.en: We have to communicate information accurately,
sentences.zh: 我们必须准确传达信息，

sentences.en: but also give people the capacity
sentences.zh: 同时也要赋予人们

sentences.en: to process and deal with psychological pain.
sentences.zh: 处理和应对心理痛苦的能力。

sentences.en: Fighting the ostrich effect means fighting a myth.
sentences.zh: 对抗鸵鸟效应意味着对抗一种迷思。

sentences.en: Avoiding information doesn't mean you're a fool.
sentences.zh: 回避信息并不意味着你是个傻瓜。

sentences.en: It means you're human.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你是个人。

sentences.zh: 本周的节目由帕斯·沙阿制作。

sentences.en: Our team includes Jenny Schmidt,
sentences.zh: 我们的团队包括珍妮·施密特、

sentences.en: Raina Cohen, Thomas Liu,
sentences.zh: 雷娜·科恩、托马斯·刘、

sentences.en: Laura Querell,
sentences.zh: 劳拉·克赖尔

sentences.en: and Aditi Bandlamudi.
sentences.zh: 和阿迪蒂·班德拉穆迪。

sentences.en: Our supervising producer is Tara Boyle.
sentences.zh: 我们的主管制片人是塔拉·博伊尔。

sentences.en: Our unsung hero this week is Sarah Gilbert.
sentences.zh: 我们本周的幕后功臣是莎拉·吉尔伯特。

sentences.en: She's the acting VP of News and Operations at NPR,
sentences.zh: 她是美国国家公共广播电台（NPR）新闻与运营的代理副总裁，

sentences.en: and she plays an important role
sentences.zh: 她在推动NPR节目播出方面

sentences.en: in getting NPR shows on the air.
sentences.zh: 发挥着重要作用。

sentences.en: She's an effective leader,
sentences.zh: 她是一位高效的领导者，

sentences.en: decisive and clear,
sentences.zh: 果断而清晰，

sentences.en: and she's always empathic
sentences.zh: 而且她总是对周围人的担忧

sentences.en: to the concerns of people around her.
sentences.zh: 感同身受。

sentences.en: She's British,
sentences.zh: 她是英国人，

sentences.en: and she tends to call people Ducky.
sentences.zh: 总是习惯叫别人“亲爱的”。

sentences.en: I thought I'd return the favor today.
sentences.zh: 我想我今天也要投桃报李一下。

sentences.en: Thanks, Ducky.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，亲爱的。

sentences.en: For more Hidden Brain,
sentences.zh: 想收听更多《隐藏的大脑》，

sentences.en: you can find us on Twitter and Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在推特和脸书上找到我们。

sentences.en: If you know someone who would like our U2.0 series,
sentences.zh: 如果你认识的人会喜欢我们的“U2.0”系列，

sentences.en: please tell them about our show.
sentences.zh: 请把我们的节目推荐给他们。

sentences.en: Next week, our series continues
sentences.zh: 下周，我们的系列节目将继续，

sentences.en: with an episode about marriage,
sentences.zh: 推出一期关于婚姻的节目，

sentences.en: when we should ask for more from our partners,
sentences.zh: 探讨我们什么时候该对伴侣要求更多，

sentences.en: and when we should ask for less.
sentences.zh: 以及什么时候该要求少一些。

sentences.en: All of us have an actual self,
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都拥有一个现实的自我，

sentences.en: the person that we currently are,
sentences.zh: 也就是我们目前的这个人，

sentences.en: but we also have an ideal self,
sentences.zh: 但我们也有一个理想的自我，

sentences.en: a version of ourselves that's aspirational.
sentences.zh: 一个我们所向往的版本的自己。

sentences.en: We look to our partners to be our sculptors,
sentences.zh: 我们指望伴侣成为我们的雕刻师，

sentences.en: to help us until we actually grow toward
sentences.zh: 帮助我们，直到我们真正朝着

sentences.en: the best ideal version of ourselves.
sentences.zh: 自己最理想的版本成长。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam,
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆，

sentences.en: and this is NPR.
sentences.zh: 这里是NPR。
